Friendly clean hand-drawn Japanese souvenir / stationery illustration, smooth rounded outlines, a few flat colors, subtle soft shading only inside objects. Thin rounded rectangular border with a small safety inset. Small decorative clusters at corners, sparse tiny accents along the outermost 12 percent edge strips. Leave the central 76 percent of width and height clear, never place anything in the middle. Long middle edge sections stay very simple so they can stretch for landscape photos. All ornaments fully inside the canvas; no cropping. No text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, watermarks, or humans. One frame only, never a sheet of variants. Theme: happy celebration party. Small pastel balloon clusters, a wrapped present, ribbon curls, golden stars and sparse colorful confetti at corners and outer edges. Fine coral-pink rounded outline with mint, lavender and gold. Cheerful refined party illustration, no typography or confetti across the center.
